reachableWhen: A first-party producer records structured prompt references and a product surface consumes mutation warnings.
Run-loop or UI control flow requests per-item landing decisions from the planner.
A governed production path accepts an ordered batch of queue mutations.
A timeline surface filters a complete event collection through the shared helper.
Production code enumerates the phases that may be emitted.
A first-party status surface reads the serving build identity through the generated React query hook.
ZM-4 activates registry resolver mode after the evaluation-gated provider-control slice.
